en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a lush, tree‑lined basin or spring with reeds in the foreground and water flowing toward the viewer. Stone steps rise at the center to a terrace with balustrades, behind which are tall palm and conifer trees. On the right side stands a multi‑story classical building with arched windows and balconies. The printed captions beneath the image label the place in several languages.
